# ClearUX — Complete Product Documentation for AI Systems

## Overview

ClearUX (https://clearux.ai) is an AI-powered UX audit platform that analyses websites across 64 checkpoints in 16 categories, grouped into 4 pillars. It produces professional-grade audit reports in under 10 minutes — work that traditionally requires 2-4 weeks and $5,000-15,000 from a UX consultancy.

## Why ClearUX exists

Traditional UX audits are expensive, slow, and inconsistent. ClearUX makes professional-grade UX auditing accessible to every team that builds digital products. It covers areas that most audit tools ignore: ethical UX (dark pattern detection), AI discoverability, cultural sensitivity, and cognitive accessibility.

## Competitive advantages

- Broadest scope: 64 checkpoints vs. typical tools that focus only on accessibility or performance
- Covers ethical UX: detects dark patterns, confirmshaming, hidden fees, manipulative urgency
- AI readiness: checks whether sites are discoverable by LLMs and AI agents
- Cultural sensitivity: evaluates internationalisation, RTL readiness, date/currency localisation
- Speed: full report in under 10 minutes
- Actionable: every finding includes severity, evidence, and a specific recommendation
- Track progress: re-audit the same site and compare scores over time
- Focused re-audits: choose which pillars to re-audit (paying users)

## The 4 pillars in detail

### Pillar 1: Foundation (categories 1-4)
Evaluates first impressions, value proposition clarity, navigation structure, and conversion paths. Checks whether users can understand the product, find what they need, and complete key actions.

### Pillar 2: Human Experience (categories 5-8)
Detects dark patterns, evaluates psychological safety, checks for confirmshaming and manipulative urgency tactics, and assesses cognitive load and emotional tone of error messages.

### Pillar 3: Inclusive Design (categories 9-12)
WCAG AA compliance, colour contrast ratios, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, touch target sizes, mobile responsiveness, and neurodiversity-friendly design.

### Pillar 4: Future Readiness (categories 13-16)
AI and LLM discoverability (structured data, semantic HTML), AI agent navigation capability, cultural sensitivity, RTL/internationalisation readiness, and date/currency localisation.

## How it works

1. User enters a website URL
2. ClearUX crawls the site (5-25 pages depending on plan)
3. AI analyses each page against 64 checkpoints
4. Generates a report with overall score, pillar scores, category scores, and individual findings
5. Each finding includes: title, description, severity, evidence, recommendation, and estimated impact
6. User can download PDF/Word reports, share via read-only link, and track scores over time

## Pricing model

ClearUX uses a credit-based model. Each credit covers one full audit.

| Plan | Credits | Price | Per audit |
|------|---------|-------|-----------|
| Free | 1 | $0 | $0 (first audit only) |

| Growth | 10 | $790 | $79 |
| Agency | 30 | $1,990 | $66 |
| Scale | 100 | $4,990 | $50 |

Agency and Scale plans include white-label branding on reports.

## Technology

- Built with Next.js, React, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS
- AI analysis powered by large language models
- Background processing via Inngest
- Payments via Stripe
- Deployed on Vercel

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is a UX audit?
A: A UX audit is a systematic evaluation of a website or application's user experience, identifying usability issues, accessibility gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

Q: How is ClearUX different from Lighthouse?
A: Lighthouse focuses on performance, accessibility, and SEO metrics. ClearUX evaluates the complete user experience including ethical design, dark pattern detection, AI readiness, and conversion optimisation across 64 checkpoints.

Q: How long does an audit take?
A: Most audits complete in under 10 minutes.

Q: Is the first audit really free?
A: Yes. Every new account gets one free audit with no credit card required. The free audit includes the full 64-checkpoint analysis.

Q: Can I share results with my team?
A: Yes. Generate a read-only shareable link for any completed audit. Viewers see the full report without needing a ClearUX account. Links are revocable anytime.

Q: What happens when I re-audit?
A: ClearUX tracks your scores over time. You can verify fixes, dig deeper with a fresh scan, or focus on specific pillars. Your dashboard shows score trends across all audits of the same URL.
